verdict.rationale: Ramp documents user-defined rules that fire automatically on spend events. Rules-based workflows route requests by vendor type, spend category or dollar amount (ramp-docs-23). Personalized workflows notify the right people based on spend amount or team role (ramp-docs-12). In-policy expenses are auto-approved (ramp-docs-32), and the agents site describes a customizable human-in-the-loop policy that auto-approves routine spend (ramp-supp-agents-site). The documented actions are narrow, though: approval routing, notifications and pre-spend blocks, not a general event-to-action rule builder. Webhooks only push events to an external endpoint, so they are a developer building block rather than in-product rules. Missing for 10: a general-purpose rule/automation builder with arbitrary trigger-to-action chains, detailed documentation of rule configuration and supported triggers/actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
